title: MergeRequest
description: Which slice's worktree to merge, and the branch to merge its branch into.

folder.description: A worktree this mode made, relative to the project, such as .forge/worktrees/my-slice. It has no changed or untracked files.

into.description: The branch to merge the slice's branch into. It is checked out nowhere, or only in the project's own folder; never in another worktree. It has no .. and does not start with a dash.
